name: 2 K, 2.6 GHz superconducting RF-cavity resonance characterization
plain_name: 2 K, 2.6 GHz superconducting RF-cavity resonance characterization
description: Measure and stabilize the resonance response of a bare superconducting RF cavity in a vertical helium test stand, following the reported Fermilab experiment.

sources.citation: PI Loop Resonance Control for the Dark Photon Experiment at 2 K Using a 2.6 GHz SRF Cavity

requirements.rationale: The paper operates the cavity at 2 K.
Cavity RF coupling, pickup and resonance acquisition are indispensable.

missing_information: Q0, RF field/power, coupler calibration, microphonics, quench onset and cryogenic dynamic heat loads are not inferred from a temperature/frequency match.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
